clauses.title: General requirements for cast
clauses.text: 1.1 General requirements for cast iron fittings for pressure pipes for water, gas and sewage.

clauses.title: Applicable to all cast
clauses.text: 1.2 Applicable to all cast iron fittings having spigots, sockets or flanges as specified in this standard and also to fittings with other type of joints, the general dimensions of which, except those relating to the joints, conform to this standard.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2.1 Material —The metal used for the manufacture of pipes shall be of a quality not less than that  of the specified  standard.
